items.summary: Global pop sensation Blackpink have been chosen as Time magazine's 2022 Entertainer of the Year, making the four-woman band the second K-pop artists to earn the title, after BTS in 2020.

items.title: Gabourey Sidibe reveals she's been secretly married for over a year
items.summary: It turns out that Gabourey Sidibe has been even busier than previously thought since the beginning of the pandemic.
